notes: September 14 report corrected on September 15 after the watering time was confirmed. All 30 pots are accounted for. The earlier weigh-ins remain valid; the 20 watered pots are now waiting for their first drained weight.

Watering for A1–F3, G1 and G2 is now recorded at approximately 8:30 p.m. Eastern on September 14. Weigh-ins ran from 7:41 to 8:23 p.m., before watering. Only the 20 active Water timestamps changed; the scale readings, saved-at times and feeding details were preserved.

A1–F3 received MSU at 0.75 g/gal; G1 and G2 received plain RO. Record one comparable drained weight for each watered pot. Their displayed latest weights are pre-water context, so a current-cycle change, daily rate and plateau are unavailable until new readings exist. No repeat watering or feeding is needed.
#3 still lacks its first post-water weight after September 13. The larger weigh list includes these baseline follow-ups and does not establish a permanent daily weighing schedule.

A dry-reference hit and a sustained plateau remain independent reasons to inspect. Root-zone moisture and plant condition still determine whether to water; reaching a previous pre-water weight does not prove that the medium is dry.

The other pots retain the September 14 recommendations. H1, H2 and H3 have no newer Water record and remain conditional Check / Water candidates with plain RO. If they were also watered, record the actual event and mix instead of repeating it. G3 remains a leaf-cycle check only.

#1 and #2 were deferred for the September 14 session because neither had a supported plateau or reached reference. Their next routine sample is September 15, sooner if plant condition changes. This page preserves the September 14 recommendations; the next scheduled review covers September 15.
